permissionSample.zh-CN: 补充成员 ID 和记录样本后，可执行权限策略复核。
permissionSample.en-US: Provide a member ID and record sample to review the permission policy.

permissionReady.zh-CN: 可使用代表性成员和记录数据执行权限策略复核。
permissionReady.en-US: Review the permission policy with a representative member and record data.

permissionDenied.zh-CN: 权限策略复核结果：拒绝。

permissionAllowed.zh-CN: 权限策略复核结果：允许。

decisionMatched.zh-CN: 决策版本复核结果：命中。

decisionNotMatched.zh-CN: 决策版本复核结果：未命中。

workflowReady.zh-CN: 可使用流程实例和业务记录样本执行 工作流规则复核。
workflowReady.en-US: Review workflow rules with a process instance and business record sample.

workflowSample.zh-CN: 补充流程样本和记录数据后，可执行 工作流规则复核。
workflowSample.en-US: Provide a process sample and record data to review workflow rules.

workflowDisabled.zh-CN: 当前运行态未启用 工作流回放服务。
workflowDisabled.en-US: The workflow replay service is unavailable in this runtime.

workflowClosed.zh-CN: 工作流分派规则复核失败：规则执行异常，已失败关闭，未使用静态审批人兜底。
workflowClosed.en-US: Workflow assignment review failed: the rule failed closed; no static approver fallback was used.

workflowFailed.zh-CN: 工作流规则复核失败，请检查规则绑定、流程样本和决策版本。
workflowFailed.en-US: Workflow review failed. Check rule bindings, the process sample and decision version.

assignmentNotMatched.zh-CN: 工作流分派规则复核已执行：未命中候选人规则。
assignmentNotMatched.en-US: Workflow assignment review executed: no candidate rule matched.

assignmentMatched.zh-CN: 工作流分派规则复核已执行：已解析候选审批人。
assignmentMatched.en-US: Workflow assignment review executed: candidate approvers resolved.

workflowNotMatched.zh-CN: 工作流规则复核结果：未命中。

workflowMatched.zh-CN: 工作流规则复核结果：命中。

slaReady.zh-CN: 可使用流程实例、租户和任务样本执行 SLA 节点复核。
slaReady.en-US: Review an SLA node with process instance, tenant and task samples.

slaSample.zh-CN: 补充流程实例、租户和任务样本后，可执行 SLA 节点复核。
slaSample.en-US: Provide process instance, tenant and task samples to review an SLA node.

sampleContext.zh-CN: 需要补充样本上下文后再复核。

decisionFailed.zh-CN: 决策版本复核失败，请检查决策版本与样本上下文。
decisionFailed.en-US: Decision review failed. Check the decision version and sample context.

decisionNotExecuted.zh-CN: 决策版本复核尚未执行。

workflowFallback.zh-CN: 工作流规则复核失败：报告显示使用了兜底，请检查规则配置。
workflowFallback.en-US: Workflow review failed: the report indicates a fallback was used. Check the rule configuration.
